A '''''Nu''-class attack shuttle''' was used to transport [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]], and other [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], aboard which they would be proceeding to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balith/Legends|Balith]] to intervene in a [[Balith civil war|civil war]] there.
